name: ESP32 DevKit V1
subtitle: Wi-Fi + Bluetooth Development Board
description: ESP32 DevKit V1 is a powerful, low-cost development board with integrated Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. Ideal for IoT, home automation, robotics, and wireless projects. Easy to program with Arduino IDE, ESP-IDF, or MicroPython.
keyFeatures: Powered by ESP-WROOM-32 (Dual-core Tensilica LX6)
Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n and Bluetooth v4.2 (BLE + Classic)
30+ GPIO pins with multiple peripheral support
Supports Arduino IDE, ESP-IDF, MicroPython
On-board USB to Serial (CP2102)
Compact and breadboard friendly design

specifications.GPIO Pins: 30 Pins (ADC, DAC, I2C, SPI, PWM, UART)

faqs.q: Can I program this board using Arduino IDE?
faqs.a: Yes! ESP32 DevKit V1 is fully compatible with the Arduino IDE, ESP-IDF, PlatformIO, and MicroPython.

faqs.q: What driver is required for USB connection?
faqs.a: It uses the CP2102 USB-to-UART bridge driver, which is automatically installed on Windows 10/11.
